_help: League money settings. confirmed: true hides the 'placeholder' notice. seasonPayouts are the end-of-season prizes. weeklyPayouts is the schedule of weekly prizes (kind says how the winner is found; manual ones are entered in manualWinners). lowestPenalty/lowestCount: the lowest N scorers of each regular-season week pay that amount. fees: each owner's base fee and how much they have paid in so far (Total = base + penalties; Owe = Total - paid; a negative Owe means they overpaid). lowestOverrides: use this list instead of the computed lowest scorers for a week. penalties: extra fees, e.g. a hurt or bye-week player left in the lineup (amount is what the owner pays). payments: prize money the league has already paid out to an owner (amount > 0). toiletBowlWinner: e.g. {"2026": "chaps"} once it is decided.
feeNote: League fee is $100 plus $71 for the weekly prizes. A hurt or bye-week player left in the lineup costs $20, added to the 1st place prize.

weeklyPayouts.label: Last team to lose its undefeated record
weeklyPayouts.rule: If teams lose their last unbeaten game in the same week, the tied teams keep going until one loses and the other does not; the one that does not lose wins.

weeklyPayouts.label: Week 1: highest score
weeklyPayouts.rule: Tie-breaker: the team with the highest-scoring player.

weeklyPayouts.label: Week 2: highest-scoring starter who is not a QB
Week 4: most touchdowns by the starting lineup
weeklyPayouts.rule: Passing touchdowns count. A tie-breaker extends to the next week. Enter the winner in manualWinners.

weeklyPayouts.label: Week 5: beat the highest-scoring losing team
weeklyPayouts.rule: The prize goes to the team that beat the team with the highest score among that week's losers.

weeklyPayouts.label: After week 7: 1st place in the standings
Week 8: biggest blowout
weeklyPayouts.rule: The winner of the largest margin of victory.

weeklyPayouts.label: End of week 14: team of the top-scoring non-QB player of the season
weeklyPayouts.rule: The player with the most points on the season (not a QB); the prize goes to the team that has him.

weeklyPayouts.label: End of week 14: beat the best-ranked loser of the week
weeklyPayouts.rule: The prize goes to the team that beat the highest-ranked (by regular-season standings) team that lost in week 14.
